def: Under the EU AI Act, a model, often trained with self-supervision at scale, that shows significant generality, performs a wide range of distinct tasks competently and can be built into many downstream systems.
practice: As of November 2026, providers must keep technical documentation, adopt a copyright policy and publish a training-content summary; obligations apply since 2 August 2025, and models placed on the market earlier must comply by 2 August 2027.
